text_block_list.text:
Смарт Фалкон wins the Tokyo Daishoten.
Her
concert proves to be such a hit that
all her fans
can't fit inside the venue,
and staff need to set up
a screen
outside.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
In the middle of the performance, the
lights
suddenly dim...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
And the screen lights up with a surprise
video
showing messages of gratitude
from all of Smart
Falcon's loving
fans—starting with none other
than
Симболи Рудольф.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Emotions run high. It appears the
concert is going
to wrap up there with a
happy ending, but...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Like a true Umadol, Смарт Фалкон
requests
another chant from the crowd!
Tonight, a top
Umadol is born!
text_block_list.name: Монолог
